blocks.text: still, any more, yet, already — vaqt chizig'ida qayerdamiz?

Bu to'rt so'z bir savolga javob beradi: holat yoki harakat **kutganimizga nisbatan** qayerda turibdi? Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 16 va 95-darslar): **still** — hali ham, **yet** — hali (inkor va savolda, oxirida), **already** — allaqachon, **I still haven't** — sabrsizlik. Bu darsda yangi qatlam: **still** ning teskarisi — **not ... any more / any longer** va rasmiy **no longer**; **yet** turli zamonlarda va rasmiy **have yet to**; **already** Past Perfect va hayrat savollarida; **still** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — «**baribir**». O'zbekchada bu ma'nolar ko'pincha so'z bilan emas, fe'l shakli bilan beriladi: «yeb **bo'ldim**», «**endi** chekmayman», «hali **kelmadi**».

**still** — holat davom etyapti; **not ... any more** — holat to'xtadi. Ular bir-birining teskarisi, shuning uchun savol-javobda juft keladi: Do you **still** live in Fergana? — No, I don't live there **any more**. **any longer** ma'nosi bir xil, biroz rasmiyroq va ko'pincha vaqt, sabr haqida: I can't wait **any longer**. Ikkalasi ham gap **oxirida** turadi va fe'l **inkor**da bo'ladi. British English'da **any more** ikki so'z bilan yoziladi, American English'da **anymore** — bitta so'z. O'zbekchada: «**endi** ... -maydi», «**boshqa** ... -maydi», «... **qolmadi**».

rows: I do**n't** live with my parents **any more**.

items.text: Do you **still** play tennis? — No, I don't play **any more**.
Our old neighbours don't live here **any longer**.
She's **still** angry with me, so she doesn't call me **any more**.
items.translation: U **hali ham** mendan xafa, shuning uchun **endi** qo'ng'iroq **qilmaydi**.

blocks.text: **no longer** = **not ... any more**, lekin ikki farqi bor. (1) O'rni — gap **o'rtasida**: oddiy fe'ldan oldin (He **no longer** works here), be va yordamchidan keyin (It's **no longer** available; You'll **no longer** need it). (2) Uslubi — rasmiyroq: yangiliklar, e'lonlar, rasmiy xatlarda ko'p. **no** ning o'zi inkor, shuning uchun fe'l **tasdiq** shaklida qoladi: «He no longer doesn't work» — xato. «I no more live here» ham xato: **no more** asosan ot bilan keladi — **no more** plastic bags (endi plastik paket yo'q).

items.text: I'm afraid this ticket is **no longer** valid.
Bekzod **no longer** eats meat for health reasons.
The road is **no longer** closed, so we can drive to Charvak.
items.translation: Yo'l **endi yopiq emas**, Chorvoqqa mashinada borsak bo'ladi.

blocks.text: yet va still + inkor: kutish va sabrsizlik

**yet** faqat Present Perfect bilan emas, boshqa zamonlar bilan ham keladi: I don't know **yet**; It isn't ready **yet**; Don't go **yet**! Doim inkor yoki savolda, gap oxirida. **still** esa inkor yordamchi fe'ldan **oldin** turadi va har qanday zamon bilan ishlaydi: He **still** doesn't understand; I **still** can't find my keys; It **still** wasn't ready. Farq ohangda: **not ... yet** — neytral xabar, **still not** — «shuncha vaqt o'tdi-yu, hamon ...» (sabrsizlik yoki hayrat). Rasmiy matnda **have yet to** + fe'l = haven't ... yet: The company **has yet to** reply — kompaniya hali javob bermadi. Yana bir ma'no: **yet** = but (simple **yet** effective — oddiy, lekin samarali).

items.text: I've called three times, but she **still** isn't answering.
items.translation: Uch marta qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin u **hali ham** javob **bermayapti**.

items.text: We haven't chosen a name for the baby **yet**.
The government **has yet to** announce the new prices.
items.translation: Hukumat yangi narxlarni **hali e'lon qilgani yo'q**.

blocks.text: **already** ham gap o'rtasida turadi va istalgan zamon bilan keladi: I **already** know; She's **already** here. O'tmishdagi voqeadan oldin bo'lgan narsa — Past Perfect bilan (→ 15-dars): When we arrived, the film **had already** started. Savolda **already** hayratni bildiradi va ko'pincha gap **oxirida** turadi: Are you leaving **already**? — Shu zahoti ketyapsizmi? Is it ten o'clock **already**? Taqqoslang: Have you finished **yet**? — oddiy savol; Have you **already** finished? — «tugatib ham bo'ldingizmi? shuncha tez?». Imloga e'tibor: **already** (allaqachon) va **all ready** (hammasi tayyor) — ikki xil narsa.

items.text: When I woke up, my parents had **already** gone to work.
items.translation: Uyg'onganimda ota-onam **allaqachon** ishga ketib bo'lgan edi.

items.text: You're home **already**? I thought you'd be late.
items.translation: **Uyga kelib ham qoldingmi**? Kechikasan deb o'ylagandim.

items.text: Is everything **all ready** for the guests? — Yes, I've **already** laid the table.
items.translation: Mehmonlar uchun **hammasi tayyormi**? — Ha, dasturxonni **allaqachon** yozib qo'ydim.

blocks.text: **still** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — «**baribir**», «**shunga qaramay**»: kutilgan natija bo'lmadi, harakat davom etdi. The weather was awful, but we **still** enjoyed the trip — havo yomon edi, lekin sayohat baribir yoqdi. O'rni o'sha — gap o'rtasida; gap boshida vergul bilan ham keladi: **Still**, it was worth it. Ko'pincha **but**, **although**, **even though** dan keyin uchraydi (→ 112–113-darslar). Qaysi ma'no ekanini kontekst ko'rsatadi: «hali ham» — vaqt haqida, «baribir» — qarama-qarshilik haqida.

items.text: It was raining heavily, but they **still** played the match.
items.translation: Kuchli yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, lekin ular **baribir** o'yinni o'tkazishdi.

items.text: The job is hard. **Still**, I wouldn't change it for anything.
items.translation: Ish og'ir. **Shunday bo'lsa ham**, uni hech narsaga almashtirmagan bo'lardim.

items.text: Dilnoza knew the risks, but she **still** decided to start her own business.
items.translation: Dilnoza xavflarni bilardi, lekin **baribir** o'z biznesini boshlashga qaror qildi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I don't still smoke» → I don't smoke **any more**; «He not any more works here» → He **doesn't** work here **any more**; «I no longer don't eat meat» → I **no longer** eat meat; «I no more live here» → I **no longer** live here; «I have finished yet» → I've **already** finished; «I yet haven't decided» → I haven't decided **yet**; «I haven't still decided» → I **still** haven't decided; «She already isn't here» → She's **not** here **any more** / She's **already** gone.

Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: **still** — holat davom etyapti; **not ... any more / no longer** — holat to'xtadi; **yet** — kutyapmiz, hali bo'lmadi; **already** — kutganimizdan oldin bo'ldi. Juftliklar: **still** ↔ **not any more**, **yet** ↔ **already**. O'zbekcha «endi ...-maydi» ni ko'rsangiz — **any more** yoki **no longer**.

Bog'lanish: just / already / yet asoslari — qizil kitob, 16-dars; still / yet / already — qizil kitob, 95-dars; Present Perfect — 7–8-darslar; Past Perfect — 15-dars; gap o'rtasidagi ravishlar — 110-dars; any longer, no better (any / no + qiyosiy) — 106-dars; even — 112-dars; although, even though — 113-dars.

examples.title: **still**: longer than expected
examples.description: **still** — holat hali tugamagan, ba'zan kutilganidan uzoq davom etyapti; turli zamonlarda, gap o'rtasida.

sentences.text: Is it **still** raining, or can we go out now?
sentences.translation: **Hali ham** yomg'ir yog'yaptimi yoki endi chiqsak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: My grandfather is eighty, but he **still** drives to the market every day.
sentences.translation: Bobom sakson yoshda, lekin **hali ham** har kuni bozorga mashinada boradi.

sentences.text: Are you **still** working on that report? It's nearly midnight!
sentences.translation: **Hali ham** o'sha hisobot ustida ishlayapsanmi? Yarim tun bo'lib qoldi-ku!

sentences.text: In 2015 Madina was **still** living with her parents in Fergana.
sentences.translation: 2015-yilda Madina **hali ham** Farg'onada ota-onasi bilan yashardi.

sentences.text: We **still** have twenty minutes, so let's have a coffee.
sentences.translation: **Hali** yigirma daqiqamiz bor, qahva ichib olaylik.

sentences.text: Do you **still** keep in touch with your classmates from school?
sentences.translation: Maktabdagi sinfdoshlaringiz bilan **hali ham** aloqadamisiz?

sentences.text: The queue at the bank was **still** long when I came back an hour later.
sentences.translation: Bir soatdan keyin qaytib kelganimda bankdagi navbat **hali ham** uzun edi.

sentences.text: Jasur has lived in London for ten years, but he **still** misses Uzbek bread.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'n yildan beri Londonda yashaydi, lekin **hali ham** o'zbek nonini sog'inadi.

sentences.text: Next year Kate will **still** be at university, so she can't move abroad.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yil Keyt **hali** universitetda bo'ladi, shuning uchun chet elga ko'cha olmaydi.

sentences.text: After two operations, Grandma can **still** read without glasses.
sentences.translation: Ikki marta operatsiyadan keyin ham buvim **hali** ko'zoynaksiz o'qiy oladi.

examples.title: **not** ... **any more** / **any longer**
examples.description: Holat to'xtadi: fe'l inkorda, **any more** / **any longer** gap oxirida. O'zbekchada «endi ... -maydi», «boshqa ... -maydi».

sentences.text: Tom doesn't work here **any more** — he moved to a bank in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Tom **endi** bu yerda **ishlamaydi** — Manchesterdagi bankka o'tib ketdi.

sentences.text: I can't wait **any longer**, so please call me when you're free.
sentences.translation: **Ortiq** kuta **olmayman**, bo'shaganingizda qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: We don't use cash **any more** — we pay for everything by phone.
sentences.translation: Biz **endi** naqd pul **ishlatmaymiz** — hamma narsaga telefon orqali to'laymiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza isn't afraid of flying **any more** after that course.
sentences.translation: O'sha kursdan keyin Dilnoza **endi** uchishdan **qo'rqmaydi**.

sentences.text: The old cinema on our street isn't open **any longer**.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi eski kinoteatr **endi ishlamaydi**.

sentences.text: My son doesn't believe in Father Frost **any more**.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim **endi** Qorboboga **ishonmaydi**.

sentences.text: Why don't you play the guitar **any more**? You were so good.
sentences.translation: Nega **endi** gitara **chalmaysan**? Juda yaxshi chalarding-ku.

sentences.text: After the argument, Aziz and Bekzod didn't speak to each other **any more**.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin Aziz va Bekzod **boshqa** bir-biri bilan **gaplashmadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah won't put up with her noisy neighbours **any longer**.
sentences.translation: Sara shovqinli qo'shnilariga **ortiq chidamaydi**.

sentences.text: This printer doesn't print in colour **any more**, so we need a new one.
sentences.translation: Bu printer **endi** rangli **chiqarmaydi**, shuning uchun bizga yangisi kerak.

examples.title: Formal: **no longer**
examples.description: **no longer** = not any more, lekin gap o'rtasida va rasmiyroq (yangiliklar, e'lonlar). Fe'l tasdiq shaklida qoladi.

sentences.text: This model is **no longer** available in our shops.
sentences.translation: Bu model do'konlarimizda **endi mavjud emas**.

sentences.text: Mr Brown **no longer** works for the company.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun **endi** kompaniyada **ishlamaydi**.

sentences.text: Since the new bridge opened, the ferry is **no longer** needed.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik ochilgandan beri paromga **endi ehtiyoj yo'q**.

sentences.text: Smoking is **no longer** allowed anywhere in the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroportning hech bir joyida chekishga **endi ruxsat yo'q**.

sentences.text: Many young people **no longer** watch television at all.
sentences.translation: Ko'p yoshlar **endi** umuman televizor **ko'rmaydi**.

sentences.text: The old textile factory in Fergana is **no longer** in use.
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi eski to'qimachilik fabrikasi **endi ishlatilmaydi**.

sentences.text: After the reforms, citizens **no longer** need a visa for short trips.
sentences.translation: Islohotlardan keyin fuqarolarga qisqa safarlar uchun **endi viza kerak emas**.

sentences.text: Nilufar realised she was **no longer** interested in medicine.
sentences.translation: Nilufar tibbiyotga **endi qiziqmay** qolganini angladi.

sentences.text: Our village **no longer** has a bank, so people travel to the town.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda **endi bank yo'q**, shuning uchun odamlar shaharga qatnaydi.

sentences.text: Old passports will **no longer** be valid from next January.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yanvardan boshlab eski pasportlar **endi amal qilmaydi**.

examples.title: **still**? — No, not **any more**
examples.description: Savol-javob juftliklari: **still** bilan so'raladi, **not any more / any longer** bilan javob beriladi — yoki aksincha, «ha, hali ham».

sentences.text: Do you **still** live in Chilanzar? — No, we don't live there **any more**.
sentences.translation: **Hali ham** Chilonzorda yashaysizmi? — Yo'q, **endi** u yerda **yashamaymiz**.

sentences.text: Is Emma **still** your flatmate? — Not **any longer**; she got married.
sentences.translation: Emma **hali ham** kvartiradoshingmi? — **Endi emas**, u turmushga chiqdi.

sentences.text: Does Bekzod **still** play football? — Not **any more**, because of his knee.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **hali ham** futbol o'ynaydimi? — **Endi o'ynamaydi**, tizzasi tufayli.

sentences.text: Are you **still** angry with me? — No, I'm not angry **any more**.
sentences.translation: Mendan **hali ham** xafamisan? — Yo'q, **endi** xafa **emasman**.

sentences.text: Do they **still** sell paper maps at the station? — I don't think they do **any more**.
sentences.translation: Vokzalda **hali ham** qog'oz xaritalar sotiladimi? — Menimcha, **endi sotilmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **still** remember my first teacher's face, but not her name **any more**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi ustozimning yuzini **hali ham** eslayman, lekin ismini **endi eslolmayman**.

sentences.text: Is the museum **still** free on Sundays? — No, it isn't **any more**.
sentences.translation: Muzey yakshanba kunlari **hali ham** tekinmi? — Yo'q, **endi emas**.

sentences.text: Kate **still** works for the BBC, but she doesn't present the news **any more**.
sentences.translation: Keyt **hali ham** BBCda ishlaydi, lekin **endi** yangiliklarni **olib bormaydi**.

sentences.text: Does your grandmother **still** bake her own bread? — Yes, she **still** does, every Friday.
sentences.translation: Buvingiz **hali ham** nonni o'zi yopadimi? — Ha, **hali ham** yopadi, har juma.

sentences.text: We **still** have the car, but we don't drive it **any longer** because it's too old.
sentences.translation: Mashina **hali ham** bizda, lekin juda eski bo'lgani uchun uni **endi haydamaymiz**.

examples.title: **yet**, **still** + negative, **have yet to**
examples.description: **yet** — turli zamonlarda, inkor va savolda, oxirida; **still** + inkor — sabrsizlik; **have yet to** — rasmiy «hali ... qilmadi».

sentences.text: Have you decided where to go on holiday **yet**?
sentences.translation: Ta'tilda qayerga borishni **hal qildingizmi**?

sentences.text: I don't know **yet** whether I'll get the job.
sentences.translation: Ishga olinamanmi yo'qmi, **hali bilmayman**.

sentences.text: Don't switch off the computer **yet** — it's still updating.
sentences.translation: Kompyuterni **hali o'chirmang** — u hali ham yangilanyapti.

sentences.text: The results of the exam haven't been published **yet**.
sentences.translation: Imtihon natijalari **hali e'lon qilinmadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **still** hasn't paid me back, and it's been three months!
sentences.translation: Jasur **hali ham** qarzini **qaytarmadi**, uch oy bo'ldi-ya!

sentences.text: I've read the instructions twice, but I **still** don't understand them.
sentences.translation: Ko'rsatmalarni ikki marta o'qidim, lekin **hali ham tushunmayapman**.

sentences.text: The police **have yet to** find the person responsible.
sentences.translation: Politsiya javobgar shaxsni **hali topgani yo'q**.

sentences.text: Is the soup ready **yet**? I'm starving!
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **tayyor bo'ldimi**? Qornim juda och!

sentences.text: The new hospital was finished in May, but it **still** isn't open.
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxona mayda qurib bitkazilgan, lekin **hali ham ochilmadi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **has yet to** reply to my email, so I'll call him tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Oliver xatimga **hali javob bermadi**, shuning uchun ertaga unga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

examples.title: **already**: sooner than expected
examples.description: **already** — kutilganidan oldin; turli zamonlarda, jumladan Past Perfect bilan; savolda — hayrat (Are you leaving **already**?).

sentences.text: It's only nine o'clock, and Bekzod has **already** finished his homework.
sentences.translation: Soat endi to'qqiz, Bekzod esa uy vazifasini **allaqachon** tugatib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: When we finally got to the stadium, the second half had **already** begun.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat stadionga yetib kelganimizda ikkinchi bo'lim **allaqachon** boshlangan edi.

sentences.text: Are you leaving **already**? The party has only just started!
sentences.translation: **Shu zahoti** ketyapsizmi? Ziyofat endigina boshlandi-ku!

sentences.text: I **already** know what happened — Madina told me this morning.
sentences.translation: Nima bo'lganini **allaqachon** bilaman — Madina bugun ertalab aytdi.

sentences.text: Have you **already** spent all your salary? It's only the tenth!
sentences.translation: Butun maoshingni **sarflab ham bo'ldingmi**? Hali o'ninchi sana-ku!

sentences.text: Is it March **already**? This year is going so fast.
sentences.translation: **Mart ham keldimi**? Bu yil juda tez o'tyapti.

sentences.text: By the time the ambulance arrived, a nurse had **already** helped the injured man.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam yetib kelguncha hamshira yarador odamga **allaqachon** yordam bergan edi.

sentences.text: Don't buy any milk — Sarah has **already** bought some.
sentences.translation: Sut olmang — Sara **allaqachon** olib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: The tickets for the concert were **already** sold out by Monday.
sentences.translation: Konsert chiptalari dushanbagacha **allaqachon** sotilib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: We've only been dating for a month, but James is **already** talking about marriage.
sentences.translation: Bir oydan beri uchrashib yuribmiz, Jeyms esa **allaqachon** to'y haqida gapiryapti.

examples.title: **still** = nevertheless: but we **still** enjoyed it
examples.description: **still** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — «baribir», «shunga qaramay»: kutilgan to'siq bo'lsa ham, harakat bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The weather was terrible, but we **still** enjoyed our trip to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo dahshatli edi, lekin Edinburgga sayohatimiz bizga **baribir** yoqdi.

sentences.text: Aziz was tired after work, but he **still** helped his son with maths.
sentences.translation: Aziz ishdan charchab kelgan edi, lekin **baribir** o'g'liga matematikadan yordam berdi.

sentences.text: The flat is small and noisy. **Still**, the location is perfect.
sentences.translation: Kvartira kichik va shovqinli. **Shunday bo'lsa ham**, joylashuvi a'lo.

sentences.text: Nilufar failed the driving test twice, but she **still** didn't give up.
sentences.translation: Nilufar haydovchilik imtihonidan ikki marta yiqildi, lekin **baribir** taslim bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: The tickets were expensive; **still**, it was a concert I'll never forget.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar qimmat edi; **shunga qaramay**, bu men hech qachon unutmaydigan konsert bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I know the hotel had bad reviews, but I **still** think we should stay there.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona haqida yomon sharhlar borligini bilaman, lekin **baribir** o'sha yerda qolishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.

sentences.text: Jasur had a fever, but he **still** went to the interview.
sentences.translation: Jasurning isitmasi bor edi, lekin u **baribir** suhbatga bordi.

sentences.text: Last year the company lost money. **Still**, nobody lost their job.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili kompaniya zarar ko'rdi. **Shunday bo'lsa-da**, hech kim ishdan bo'shatilmadi.

sentences.text: We'd already eaten, but Grandma **still** made us have some plov.
sentences.translation: Biz allaqachon ovqatlanib bo'lgan edik, lekin buvim **baribir** bizga palov yedirdi.

sentences.text: Our team played badly in the first half and **still** won three–nil.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz birinchi bo'limda yomon o'ynadi, lekin **baribir** 3:0 hisobida yutdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: catching up with an old friend
examples.description: Uzoq vaqt ko'rishmagan ikki do'st suhbati: **still**, **any more**, **no longer**, **yet**, **already** — hammasi bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Oliver! I haven't seen you for ages. Are you **still** working at the bank?
sentences.translation: — Oliver! Seni ko'rmaganimga ancha bo'ldi. **Hali ham** bankda ishlayapsanmi?

sentences.text: — No, I don't work there **any more**. I left in the spring.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **endi** u yerda **ishlamayman**. Bahorda ketdim.

sentences.text: — Really? Have you found something new **yet**?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Yangi biror narsa **topdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I've **already** started at a small IT company in Manchester.
sentences.translation: — Ha, Manchesterdagi kichik IT kompaniyada **allaqachon** ishlay boshladim.

sentences.text: — Great! And do you **still** live in that tiny flat near the station?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Vokzal yaqinidagi o'sha kichkina kvartirada **hali ham** yashaysanmi?

sentences.text: — Thankfully, no. We're **no longer** renting; we bought a house.
sentences.translation: — Xayriyat, yo'q. **Endi** ijarada **yashamaymiz**, uy sotib oldik.

sentences.text: — Congratulations! Have you moved in **yet**, or is it **still** being repaired?
sentences.translation: — Tabriklayman! **Ko'chib o'tdinglarmi** yoki u **hali ham** ta'mirlanyaptimi?

sentences.text: — We **still** haven't moved in, because the kitchen isn't finished **yet**.
sentences.translation: — **Hali ham** ko'chib **o'tmadik**, chunki oshxona **hali** bitmagan.

sentences.text: — It'll be worth it. Is Emma **still** teaching at the primary school?
sentences.translation: — Arziydi. Emma **hali ham** boshlang'ich maktabda dars beryaptimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and she's **already** talking about becoming a head teacher.
sentences.translation: — Ha, u **allaqachon** direktor bo'lish haqida gapiryapti.
